next.reason: §1985:IV.4.2.2.1 SR2 (Amendment 2's text, X3.23b-1993; Errata C198): "The reserved words LENGTH, RANDOM, and SUM form an identical set with the function-names LENGTH, RANDOM, and SUM" and they "may not be used as a system-name or as a user-defined word regardless of context". 2023 states the same for these three words: each is in the reserved-word list (§2023:8.9) and in the intrinsic-function-name list (§2023:8.11; both lists checked mechanically, their overlap is LENGTH, RANDOM, SIGN, SUM), §2023:8.3.2.1 SR1 says "Reserved words shall not be used as user-defined words or system-names", and §2023:8.3.2.1 SR5 withholds from "intrinsic function names LENGTH, RANDOM, SIGN, and SUM" the leave it gives every other intrinsic-function-name to be a user-defined word or system-name. 2023's fourth word SIGN is no difference for the three words this rule names (SIGN is no 1985 function-name); it is recorded on §1985:IV.4.2.2.1 SR1, the rule for all other words.
